title: Client Side Rendering (CSR)
definition:
CSR means the server sends a barebones HTML file (`
`) and a massive JavaScript bundle. The browser must download the JS, parse it, execute it, fetch data, and THEN render the UI. This is how standard create-react-app works.
simpleExplanation: The server sends you a blank canvas and a giant box of Lego pieces, and tells your browser to build the entire house from scratch.

answers.question: Define Client Side Rendering.
answers.answer: Client Side Rendering is a critical architectural pattern in frontend design.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of Client Side Rendering?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
